warnings.description: From Saturday evening south occasionally near gale force 7. Decreasing late Sunday afternoon.
warnings.instruction: Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.

warnings.headline: Yellow Near gale 14-17 m/s Skagerrak
warnings.description:
West-southwest 14-17 m/s. Late Sunday afternoon decreasing.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Skagerrak
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute
